title: Independence Seaport Museum Admission
includes: Admission to the Museum's Building and Cruiser OLYMPIA
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Children must be accompanied by an adult
Not wheelchair accessible on two historic ships
Operates in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately. Ships will close if extreme weather such as snow, ice or high temperatures.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Climb aboard the oldest floating steel warship in the world, Cruiser OLYMPIA, and explore award-winning exhibits in the Museum's building, as well as the Seaport Boat Shop where you can watch a traditional maritime craft take place!
